patterns.problem: Owners re-publish an unanswered operator question within hours, with nothing new and no operator message in between, in three tasks.
patterns.fix: The owner instructions' paragraph on open questions says an unanswered question stays parked and is not re-asked without new information, while the owner continues unblocked work.

patterns.problem: Owners plan voucher refunds and decimal prices against decisions the operator gave in project chat; the coordinator acknowledged the decisions but its briefs never carried them.
patterns.fix: The coordinator's instructions for writing a task brief include the operator's standing project decisions from chat that bear on the task.
patterns.wrong_explanation: Owners not reading their briefs, as the coordinator suggested; ruled out because the briefs did not contain the decisions and the owners followed them as written.

decoys.why: The merge hold waiting for the final timetable was the operator's request.
A single resume failure after a scheduled maintenance restart, explained by the coordinator.
Large-PR review findings are covered by an earlier dismissed suggestion; the operator wants one PR per feature.
